levels.surface: الحسن بن عبد الله بن محمد بن علي التميمي
علي بن موسى بن جعفر بن محمد

notes: «سيدي» (my lord) is a title before the name; left out of the surface
«أبي» at two places is the transmitter's own father: relation links (rule 7)
«عن أبيه جعفر بن محمد» is one link: the name alone (rule 7)
Chain ends at علي, whose words relay the Prophet's saying; the Prophet is not a link
«(2)» and «(3)» are footnote numbers in the text, not names
